title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Tagine with Aerated Miso Glaze
description: A unique take on traditional Japanese cuisine, this dish brings together the bold flavors of Saudi Arabia with the delicate nuances of Japan. The aerated miso glaze adds a delightful twist to this hearty tagine.

ingredients.name: 1 cup saudi arabian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the saudi arabian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the funky apple cider vinegar and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the aerated miso paste and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or noodles.
